headline: West Fraser Timber Q3 Profit Declines on Persistent Housing Market Softness
summary: West Fraser Timber reported lower third-quarter profit as ongoing weakness in residential construction activity weighed on lumber demand and wood product realizations.
why: West Fraser Timber is the largest lumber manufacturer in North America; its operating performance serves as a key barometer for US residential construction and building materials markets.

impacts.name: West Fraser Timber
impacts.why: Lower quarterly earnings driven by weak North American housing and residential building conditions.
